item.title: Version 2.5.3
item.description: New in 2.5.3: two fixes from the field. The boss health bar, name and caption no longer draw over the pause menu or the game over screen: they now hide whenever a full-screen menu is up and return when you resume, with the bar showing the correct fill. Shooting enemies no longer hitches the game: the hit flash used to switch material emission on and off with every hit, which made the graphics chip compile a new shader variant on the hit frame itself. Enemy materials are now armed once when they spawn and the flash only changes brightness, and the bullet pool and shot effects are prepared before the run starts instead of growing during the first shots.

item.title: Version 2.5.2
item.description: New in 2.5.2: two field fixes and a living savanna. Shooting Prince Reginald no longer drags the frame rate down: the hit effects were reallocating their particle buffers on every shot, and they are now pooled and budgeted once, with cosmetic bursts paced per enemy while damage, the hit flash and health bars still land on every hit. The grass can no longer disappear: it was being thinned by rewriting its instance buffer, which threw away the placement data on real graphics hardware, and thinning now changes only how much grass is drawn. Grass is always present now, with Low and High density settings only. Every kind of grass sways in the wind, and grass bends away from Jax and from nearby enemies as they move through it.

item.title: Version 2.5.1
item.description: New in 2.5.1: a performance and polish pass. The big one is performance: every texture in the game was shipping uncompressed, which made the graphics chip carry about 4.5 times more texture memory than it should. Textures are now VRAM compressed, Auto quality is capped sensibly on Intel integrated graphics, and a frame rate watchdog steps quality down before a heavy fight can chug. The boss banner no longer overlaps your boons list, so boss introductions read cleanly. Lion fur and ground detail have been softened, so they read as fur and sand instead of scribble. The snake has been rebuilt as one continuous scaled body, slither and all, including Professor Huggington himself.

item.title: Version 2.5.0
item.description: New in 2.5.0: a full texture upgrade across the savanna. Every animal now wears a detailed 2048px coat (fur, scales, feathers, shell and hide), and the world gained real textures for rock, crate wood, acacia bark and leaves, barrels, canyon walls, waterhole mud and grass, with subtle detail maps on High and Ultra. The 2.4.0 work is all here too: the graphics boost on stronger Macs (Ultra renders at 1800x1125 with 8x MSAA), power-ups that land properly (Mud Bath overheals into a visible shield, timed effects last 18 seconds with an on-screen countdown, a guaranteed marked pickup every wave, drafted boons shown on the HUD), much harder bosses with a bite that hits at 1.75x, predators that visibly bite down (jaws open on the wind-up and slam shut on the damage frame, and a bite only lands when the head reaches you), full gamepad support (wired and Bluetooth) with twin-stick aim, mouse-look in third person, first-person view waiting at Prestige Tier 4, and the story crossfade fix. Updating also changed: the game now asks before it installs anything, you can scan for updates yourself in Settings, and Settings can also go back one version if an update does not suit you.
